Run 2 on the same build had no such 500. Round 22's run, before #2391's merge, had none either. I could not take a base pair: run-step refuses main 225f2bea on the 0161 seed, and a reseed with main costs about 40 minutes. A one-row insert waiting 10 s points at the shared pool being saturated at start; whether #2391's woken loops, this PR's startup recovery pass, or the box (2 vCPU) caused it is not settled. Both runs are uploaded.
